description_en: Calls the DeleteGateway operation to delete a registered gateway
description_zh: 调用DeleteGateway删除已录入的网关
name: DeleteGateway

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.
You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must pass in this ID value. Otherwise, the call will fail.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gw_eui
